name: New server setup
description: A user with your SSH key, a firewall, fail2ban, automatic updates and Docker, then a check that it all works. For servers tagged new.

nodes.command:
set -e
id {{input.user}} >/dev/null 2>&1 || adduser --disabled-password --gecos '' {{input.user}}
usermod -aG sudo {{input.user}}
mkdir -p /home/{{input.user}}/.ssh
echo '{{input.ssh_key}}' >> /home/{{input.user}}/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown -R {{input.user}}: /home/{{input.user}}/.ssh
chmod 700 /home/{{input.user}}/.ssh
chmod 600 /home/{{input.user}}/.ssh/authorized_keys

set -e
apt-get update -q
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ufw
ufw allow OpenSSH
ufw --force enable

set -e
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y fail2ban unattended-upgrades docker.io
systemctl enable --now fail2ban docker
usermod -aG docker {{input.user}}
